args.sql: SELECT p.pesticide_name AS "药剂", l.city AS "地市", f.date_id AS "日期", f.lc50 AS "LC50", f.corrected_mortality AS "校正死亡率", f.resistance_level AS "抗性分类" FROM fact_insecticide_resistance f JOIN dim_species s ON f.species_id = s.species_id JOIN dim_pesticide p ON f.pesticide_id = p.pesticide_id JOIN dim_location l ON f.location_id = l.location_id ORDER BY f.date_id DESC
